translations.web: Then all the assembly answered with a loud voice, “We must do as you have said concerning us.
translations.bsb: And the whole assembly responded in a loud voice: “Truly we must do as you say!
translations.kjv: Then all the congregation answered and said with a loud voice, As thou hast said, so must we do.
